# Dreamsfield Hotel & Lounge

Dreamsfield Hotel & Lounge is a luxury destination in Ibadan offering premium accommodation, nightlife, and culinary experiences.

## Core Offerings
- **Luxury Rooms**: Standard, Deluxe, Executive Suites, and Penthouse Suites.
- **Bar & Lounge**: Exclusive nightlife, signature cocktails, and a vibrant atmosphere.
- **Kitchen**: Local Nigerian delicacies and intercontinental cuisine.

## Location
Akala Express, Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria.

## Contact
- Phone: +234 800 DREAMSFIELD
- General inquiries: info@dreamsfieldhotels.com
- Reservations: reservations@dreamsfieldhotels.com

## Online Ordering
Guests can place food and drink orders online at https://dreamsfieldhotels.com/menu for dine-in (room service / table service) or takeaway.
